cdc_review.vendor_resets: Two MIG asynchronous reset combiners feed vendor synchronized deassertion chains. Startup releases once; clock/delay lock inputs retain vendor behavior. CDC-8 also flags the 15-stage reference reset chain without ASYNC_REG.
cdc_review.temperature: Vendor external temperature bus uses five ASYNC_REG stages, equality/stability checking and a saturating 4-bit counter before output capture.
cdc_review.mailbox_snapshot: Held request/response payloads use toggle synchronizers and four explicit max-delay/bus-skew constraints; snapshot payload remains held until the next request. Request while busy is rejected.
cdc_review.scope: Review of this experimental diagnostic for SRAM testing. Residual vendor CDC reports are retained; this is not a claim of an empty CDC report or physical qualification.

limitations: Vendor first-error address/data record is pipeline-misaligned and unverified; use sticky byte-lane/cycle/ECC counts.
